Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.mandela.vm

Interface Machine

All Known Implementing Classes:
VM
public interface Machine
The services a script can reach from inside the machine.

The built-in method table (upper(), map { }, json.encode()) needs both to call back into script code and to ask the host for a side effect, and it must not know whether the host is the CLI, an Espresso panel or a web page. This interface is that seam: the VM implements it, the standard library consumes it, and tests can supply a fake that records calls instead of performing them.

      void write(String text)
      Writes characters to the script's own console channel, with no terminator.
